title: A worker searches the backlog before it files a bug, so it files no duplicate of an open draft
goal: The worker rules (the brief's fixed rules and the role file's rule 5) tell a worker to run backlog.py find WORDS before backlog.py new bug and to add its evidence as a note to an item it finds (an open draft, or a host-load bug such as BG-w6z2zc6r) instead of filing a duplicate, as BG-w3p7fqy2 repeated ST-fxz2wrfe and BG-vrijmdre repeated BG-w6z2zc6r

run: import sys;sys.path.insert(0,'_tools');import bl_dispatch as d;t=' '.join(r if isinstance(r,str) else ' '.join(r) for r in d.WORKER_RULES);sys.exit(0 if '{backlog} find' in t else 1)
import sys;ls=[l for l in open('agents/worker.md',encoding='utf-8') if l.startswith('5. ')];sys.exit(0 if ls and 'backlog.py find' in ls[0] else 1)

gates.question: Which open items does the worker's find step stop on before it files a bug?
options: any item not done or dropped (draft, todo or doing): its evidence goes in a note there
drafts only: a todo or doing item is left to its own worker

notes: Merged from ST-3p3y2vnv “dispatch names the open host-load bugs in every brief so workers do not file duplicates” at the 2026-10-13 draft triage: Same failure as ST-lp5pxtpe: workers file duplicates of known bugs (BG-vrijmdre for BG-w6z2zc6r). A find-before-filing rule covers the host-load bugs without a hand-fed list. Its goal: backlog.py brief lists each open bug that names a whole-suite failure or ceiling overrun on a loaded host (such as BG-w6z2zc6r) as a known failure without a --known flag, so a worker does not file a duplicate (SP-kuhlsf2s's research worker filed BG-vrijmdre for BG-w6z2zc6r) Its checks: {"run": ["python3", "_tools/backlog.py", "brief", "ST-wifnsrg6"]} Planned at the 2026-10-13 draft triage (sprint 14 of 15, "Gates and filing: words do not misclass a gate, workers file no duplicates and add gates with their do map"): it fixes a failure that recurred in recent sprints and blocks the EP-gzr4mmkm fitness test that a content sprint lands on headless Sonnet workers with no operator step beyond its gates. Planned: the brief tests are in test_backlog_portable.py, not test_land_e2e.py; the suite sits at max_ids 100, so extend the brief test there and rename it to carry brief_find_before_filing, no new id. Orders after ST-cr6lmafy (same bl_dispatch.py). Premise run 2026-10-13 at planning: bl_dispatch.WORKER_RULES holds no find step (its file-a-bug rule names only commit and report) and rule 5 of agents/worker.md names backlog.py new bug with no find before it; both planned checks fail before the work.
